explainability.note: Attributions describe ASSOCIATION: which sensors the trained model relies on when it predicts RUL. They do not show that a sensor causes degradation or failure. Permutation importance measures reliance for accuracy on the validation split; Integrated Gradients measures how each sensor's deviation from the train-mean operating point moves an individual prediction. Sensors are correlated in C-MAPSS, so credit can be shared or shifted between correlated sensors.
